name: kubernetes-mcp-server
stderr:
Error: unknown flag: --stdio
Usage:
  kubernetes-mcp-server [flags]

Examples:
  # show this help
  kubernetes-mcp-server -h
  
  # shows version information
  kubernetes-mcp-server --version
  
  # start STDIO server
  kubernetes-mcp-server
  
  # start a Streamable HTTP server using a TOML config file
  kubernetes-mcp-server --config /path/to/config.toml
  
  # start using only a drop-in directory
  kubernetes-mcp-server --config-dir /path/to/conf.d

Flags:
      --config string       Path of the config file.
      --config-dir string   Directory of lexical .toml files. Usable alone or with --config. Omitted means no drop-ins. Relative paths are resolved against the working directory.
  -h, --help                help for kubernetes-mcp-server
      --version             Print version information and quit
